title: ELF Object File Format 4.2, Chapter 5 Symbol Table
readSections: 5.1 Symbol Table Entry: Elf64_Sym layout and ST_BIND/ST_TYPE
application: Local function names are file-scoped and cannot uniquely identify externally linked audited targets. Lookup accepts defined GLOBAL/WEAK functions, keeps exact nonlocal extent and binding conflict rejection, and records excluded local collisions separately.
policyDistinction: Rejecting conflicting retained GLOBAL/WEAK entries is a conservative auditor rule. It is not a claim that every such synthetic combination is invalid under the ABI linker resolution rules.
reproduction: No external source code, diagram, table or long text copied. Independently authored metadata parser adjustment and synthetic fixtures only.
limitation: The exact conflicting symbol from the failed hosted binary remains unobserved until the new GNU audit runs; the parser correction and MSVC regression do not prove Linux acceptance.
